files.description: Product code changes (150 rows): product (name with model), stock_qty (whole number), old_code and new_code (four-digit whole numbers; the code is unchanged in 100 rows). No empty cells.

task_text: Index the table by old_code so that it can be used as a lookup of the new code. For every row, in file order, tell whether the new code is higher than the old code. `result` should be the sequence of True/False values.
intended_computation: 150 booleans in file order: new_code > old_code.

acceptable_variants.notes: a list, array or Series of 150 booleans is acceptable; labels of a Series are free.

predicted_direction.reason: The values are the same on both versions; only the container changes (NumPy array on 2.x, Series labelled by old codes on 3.x), and the task accepts either.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
